description: One Capture per page, in page order: each member is the exact body that page's origin sent, with the same HTTP details web.fetch records (url is the page's built URL) plus page_index (0-based) and page_count. A page without a Capture is listed in failed_pages and the result is then incomplete, so nothing is retired because a record is missing from it. A request with no values to page over has no pages: captures is empty and the result is complete.
name: web.fetch.pages.result
